title: ジャパンダートダービーの後に・スキ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon gives her all in the Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dirt races are a battle of endurance. Although she has to push her tired body during the concert, she says she loves the feeling of giving it everything she has.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to share that love of dirt races and concerts with crowds just as large as the ones G1 turf races attract.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a stepping stone towards her goal, she sets her sights on the JBC Classic for her next race, where she'll be able to compete against senior-year racers.
